zh.title: 美國航空終止非自願拒載 改以延遲班機換志願者
zh.summary: 美航終止非自願拒載；要求員工先找志願者並可延遲航班
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）終止非自願拒絕載運旅客的做法，改要求員工尋找志願者，即使可能因此延遲航班或付出更高賠償，公司也願意接受。
這項政策調整見於 Simple Flying 的報導，內容指出航空公司將結束非自願性的拒載安排。報導中也說明，替代方案是尋找自願下機的乘客，必要時可延誤航班或增加賠償。
此次變更屬於民航營運程序的調整，報導中並未提供官方文件、具體時間表或規管行動等細節。

en.title: American Airlines Ends Involuntarily Bumping Passengers From Flights
en.summary: American Airlines ends involuntary bumping; staff ordered to find volunteers, even if delays result.
body: American Airlines is ending the practice of involuntarily removing passengers from flights. The carrier said it will instead ask employees to find volunteers, even if that means delaying flights or paying out more compensation.
The development was reported by Simple Flying, which notes that the airline is putting an end to involuntary bumping and aiming to rely on volunteers for denied boarding situations.

The report presents this as an operational policy, without mentioning official documents, a detailed timeline, or regulatory action. Further specifics on enforcement or timing are not included in the coverage.
